reviews.text:
A must get! Improvement on old app, no sound combining yet. I’ve been using myNoise on my iPad for years, mostly via the older app, some via the website. myNoise helps me greatly with insomnia, stress, and tinnitus, transports me from my limited surroundings, and brings me much happiness.

The new app has a much more attractive, intuitive, and efficient interface. And it still does not sell our data. Hurray! Thank you! 🙏

I rave about myNoise every chance I get, and I always highlight 2 things: the huge library of incredibly skillful, beautiful, and varied recordings, and the ability to mix sounds into new soundscapes. The new app includes the complete selection of recordings, but I am eagerly awaiting the track combining feature. I need a purring kitty beside my roaring fireplace, after all!

I have a feature request. Please give us a way to export even just a simple text list of our downloaded and favorited soundscapes, so that if we lose that information due to getting a new device, we can recreate them. I have grieved losing all of them when I got a new iPad. I guess I could take screenshots. I should probably do that as a precaution. But a feature to make this easier would be welcomed! (Update: I just got word that the team will be looking into something to address this!)

I recommend to all myNoise users to read the app and website information thoroughly, and explore what you can do. There are lots of details that are not immediately obvious.

Kudos to developer Stéphane and his helpers. What an amazing labor of love, that truly makes so many lives better.

The app’s neatest feature is that every soundscape is itself a creative playground with lots of additional soundscapes hidden inside, so you can tailor the sliders to fit the feeling that works best for you. For me, I tend to like combinations that emphasize bass and pads.

I’ve been a myNoise supporter for years there’s noting else like it. And I’m excited about this modernized, thoughtfully-designed iOS app. I hope that it signals a long life ahead for one of my favorite creative tools.

reviews.text:
Passion Project - Support It Now. I’ve been using this app and website for probably a decade at least. I share it with everyone and tell them to support it. Really happy with the newest version of the app.

Sometimes you come across apps where you can tell someone made it to genuinely help others and as a passion project. There is no data collection. You are not required to pay a subscription. It’s $20 for optional “lifetime support.” It’s even worded like that. If that sounds like a steep donation consider this:

1 There are so many sound scapes. At least 50 but I bet there’s more. Almost anything you can think of: rain to dark creepy whispers to sitting in a coffee shop to walking in a forest. 

2 The soundscapes can be actual recordings of real noises or generated or both.

3 The different tones are separated, and completely adjustable. Example: it’s the jungle, but you can turn down that one bug noise and it becomes YOUR perfect jungle. 

4 There are 10 fully adjustable sliders for EVERY sound scape.

5 The way it works never sounds like a loop and it’s not like some set amount of time where it ends and jumps to another one. It just keeps the noise going indefinitely with all the different tones that you chose. There are features surrounding this like timers and alarms like you’d expect but I don’t personally use them. 

6 Each sound scape has multiple creative presets for you to try. Even animating the sliders over time. It’s incredibly soothing waking up to the rain tones slowly adjusting as you are falling back asleep. 

7 It’s difficult to describe the perfect personalized sound massage until you experience it.

8 The newest version of the app has the greatest feature yet: you can download your personalized or some preset soundscape for offline listening… That’s right you don’t even need an internet connection anymore to use it. And it won’t cut out if your internet drops out. Absolutely incredible.

9 I know it has helped many folks. Diagnosed and not. 

10 Personally, it’s so high quality and useful I’ve donated to this app multiple times on top of the lifetime support because it is absolutely deserved.

In summary: it’s very high quality and clearly made with passion and kindness with no stipulations. 

To the creator, Dr. Ir. Stéphane Pigeon,
Thank you

reviews.text: So immersive. I love this app! I use it as ambience when reading, to relax or falling sleep, and as background sounds while focusing or if I need to shut out sounds around me (I have some sound sensitivities). There are so many soundscapes and vibes to choose from. And they sound great, not fuzzy, muddled, shrill, or artificial the way a lot of ambience/soundscapes sound to me. I love being able to fine tune the sounds within the soundscape and the animate feature can be enabled so it’s realistic and not repetitive. Listened across all kinds of headphones, but recently got a good pair of Sennheisers and the soundscape quality is amazing, whole new level of immersion! With animate on, and with sounds that pan or move a little, it’s mind-blowing how fun this app becomes 🫶
